strongest_surviving_target_inference.why_warranted: R01 satisfies all four properties: the stipulated independent authenticated copies support a comparative weakening of alteration, applying the source instrument to a material and target-relevant score-entry question.

scope_survival.rationale: The advertised analysis covered all scoring, specifications, contacts and intent. Only the examined-entry inference and limits on broader conclusions survive.

mechanism_survival.rationale: The local mechanism remains intact: explicit competing explanations, comparison against independent evidence, and weakening of alteration. Its application is confined to one entry.

remainder_check.rationale: R01 retains the instrument's comparative weakening of an explanation; R02 retains its constraint against extrapolating beyond tested alternatives and evidence.

target_contribution_survival.rationale: The comparison constrains one possible steering route and blocks unsupported award-wide conclusions.

dependency_cascade.rationale: Deletion removes the broad exoneration conclusions across several branches while leaving the independently supported entry-level comparison and evidential limits.

central_bridge.rationale: Neither the local weakening of alteration nor the limits on extrapolation depends on any deleted claim.

structural_conflict.explanation: The viable candidates support reduced scope. Survival of the local reasoning mechanism is consistent with loss of the broader target conclusions.
